tools.name: safefood360_list_documents
tools.description: List controlled documents of the Safefood 360 site (title, description, version, folder, responsible person, review/approval workflow, created/modified). Supports OData $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count. GET /documents/sites/{siteId}/v1/documents/.

tools.name: safefood360_get_document
tools.description: One controlled document by its identifier: title, description, version, folder, responsible person and workflow. GET /documents/sites/{siteId}/v1/documents/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_list_document_reviews
tools.description: List document reviews (the periodic review records of controlled documents). Supports OData $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count; use it to find reviews that are due or overdue. GET /documents/sites/{siteId}/v1/documentreviews/.

tools.name: safefood360_get_document_review
tools.description: One document review by its review number. GET /documents/sites/{siteId}/v1/documentreviews/{no}.

tools.name: safefood360_list_complaints
tools.description: List customer complaints (number, name, risk, date, company, source, contact person, product/material, description, created/modified). Supports OData $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count. GET /complaints/sites/{siteId}/v1/complaints.

tools.name: safefood360_get_complaint
tools.description: One complaint by its id (GUID). GET /complaints/sites/{siteId}/v1/complaints/{id}.

tools.name: safefood360_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (name, code, addresses, contacts, approval status, risk, establishment numbers). Paged with start_index and limit; the reply carries recordCount and next_start_index. GET /v1/suppliers/?siteId=.

tools.name: safefood360_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by its external id. GET /v1/suppliers/{externalId}?siteId=.

tools.name: safefood360_list_materials
tools.description: List materials/ingredients (name, our code, supplier code, description, category, countries of origin, risk, archived flag). Paged with start_index and limit; the reply carries recordCount and next_start_index. GET /v1/materials/?siteId=.

tools.name: safefood360_get_material
tools.description: One material by its external id. GET /v1/materials/{externalId}?siteId=.

tools.name: safefood360_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by its identifier (name, addresses, phone, notes). The vendor offers no customer list. GET /customers/sites/{siteId}/v1/customers/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_get_employee
tools.description: One employee record by its identifier (training/HR master data of the site). Contains personal data: use it only for the question asked. The vendor offers no employee list. GET /employees/sites/{siteId}/v1/employees/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_get_final_product
tools.description: One final (finished) product by its identifier: name, folder, categories, barcode, specifications and the materials it is made of. The vendor offers no final-product list. GET /finalproducts/sites/{siteId}/v1/finalproducts/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_get_batching_record
tools.description: One batching (traceability) record by its id (GUID). GET /batching/sites/{siteId}/v1/batching/records/{recordId}.

tools.name: safefood360_update_document
tools.description: WRITE: change the title, description and/or folder of a controlled document in Safefood 360 (JSON patch; fields you leave out stay as they are). It does not publish a new version or change the review workflow. Returns the updated document. PATCH /documents/sites/{siteId}/v1/documents/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change the name, phone, mobile and/or notes of a customer in Safefood 360 (JSON patch of those fields; others stay as they are). notes REPLACES the existing notes. PATCH /customers/sites/{siteId}/v1/customers/{identifier}.

tools.name: safefood360_create_complaint
tools.description: WRITE: record a NEW complaint in Safefood 360 (it may trigger the site's complaint workflow and notifications). Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two complaints. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: safefood360_list_documents, safefood360_list_document_reviews, safefood360_get_document_review · Private data: safefood360_list_documents, safefood360_get_document, safefood360_list_document_reviews, safefood360_get_document_review, safefood360_list_complaints, safefood360_list_suppliers, safefood360_get_employee, safefood360_get_batching_record, safefood360_update_document, safefood360_create_complaint · Public sink: safefood360_update_document, safefood360_create_complaint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: safefood360_list_documents, safefood360_list_document_reviews, safefood360_get_document_review · Private data: safefood360_list_documents, safefood360_get_document, safefood360_list_document_reviews, safefood360_get_document_review, safefood360_list_complaints, safefood360_list_suppliers, safefood360_get_employee, safefood360_get_batching_record, safefood360_update_document, safefood360_create_complaint · Public sink: safefood360_update_document, safefood360_create_complaint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
